title: Bald shin patches and Jack's tumors sent to Air Force pathology institute
place_text: Vermont teaching hospital; Air Force Institute of Pathology near Washington DC

tellings.quote: had tumors growing in the exact spots on his legs.

plain: In 1976, according to a man named Jack Weiner, bald patches appeared on his shins and he later "had tumors growing in the exact spots on his legs." A Vermont teaching hospital sent the tissue on to an Air Force pathology institute near Washington. Charlie Foltz, who says he was a witness to the events around Weiner, tells Michels this as Weiner told it to him, during a conversation about alien abduction, and he points to a pathology report on Weiner's tumor. If true, the Air Force was taking a close interest in physical marks on a man who said he had been taken by aliens.
